draft.subject: Your weekly summary question + first project
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

On your open ticket: a weekly summary email isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap -- sorry for the manual screenshots in the meantime. I'll keep you posted as it moves.

Since we spoke, I also wanted to close the loop on getting Lantern Ventures set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is the thing that makes everything else useful.

Want me to walk through that first project with you on a short call this week?

Best,
Nadia
